quickref.status: BB Heroes only (added Summer 2023 per wiki; BBH still live Sept 2026); not in BBG 2013-2021 or BBG 2026
quickref.look: Squat teal-blue drum launcher (#35729B-#3F89AF) with a yellow band (#F6E03F), white side lamps and a brown-wrapped top handle (#44332C). Engraved grey face plate with four silver-rimmed bores, each loaded with a hot-pink Huggable (#E83ACD-#F13CDD). About 0.3x her height across the face; carried at the hip by the handle or heaved onto the right shoulder. Skins recolour it, e.g. a gold frame with an olive body [Observed]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Wide grey aim wedge, roughly 40-50 degrees; wiki says 15 x 190 damage with 'Very slow' reload [Fan-wiki]. Muzzle flash is a violet-pink starburst (#D0AAE3) with pink streaks, and the bores glow pink. 'Huggable bits' [Canon] show in matches as a fan of magenta streaks and star-puffs with white/pale-yellow sparkles reaching about 3-4 bear-lengths; one hero-screen tile shows a whole pink Huggable flying out [Observed, low-res]
quickref.impact_end_result: Pink-and-orange fleck bursts on hit (#BC629C/#C7795A) [Observed]. 'HAS KILLED' banners appear, but the defeat look, status effects and knockback are unverified

quickref.status: BB Heroes only; the in-game skill panel names it 'Healing Turret' (2026 upload); not in BBG
quickref.look: Small object (the wiki's 'HealBox', 3360 HP) on a pale-blue ring (#80C8DA) with its own HP readout. It is only a few pixels at storyboard resolution (dark brown/olive with green on top) and no gun barrel is visible. It projects a translucent green dome about 6 bear-widths across (fill #4C7335-#547B3A, rim #76AC5F, highlight #A7E579) [Observed]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Does not fire. Pale-green '+' sparkles (#BCEC84) drift up inside the dome [Observed]; 468 healing per second, Range 'Very long' [Fan-wiki]. Deploy method and duration unverified
quickref.impact_end_result: Heals Saberi and teammates inside the radius, 'excluding non-player units' [Canon]. The box has HP and can be destroyed [Fan-wiki; Observed readout 3198]; its destruction look and any heal glow on allies are unverified

quickref.look: Default 3D model: white knotted bandana with ear-like ends (#DAD9E3), blonde fringe, tan-brown fur (#726242), dark eyes, near-black navy suit (#2E2F39) with a yellow chest cross, yellow sleeves, teal gloves (#60D1CB), yellow tool belt and red backpack. The long blonde hair, gold tiara and white top in 'Matches with Saberi' is a skin of unknown name. Other Medic skins: Huggable Hunter, Skull Driver, and a pink-hoodie boxing look in SkyVu shorts [Observed]
quickref.impact_end_result: Not applicable. Official BBH key art also shows the classic red polka-dot Saberi holding an unidentified orange gun with a flared grey cone nozzle [Observed; identity unverified]

What is the long-blonde / gold-tiara / white-top Medic skin called, and how is it unlocked? Does every Saberi skin re-colour the Huggable Splicer?

What is the orange flared-nozzle gun Saberi holds in SkyVu's BBH key art (wiki file BBH_Splash.png; same art as the official skins-tour thumbnail and the trailer end card): early Splicer concept art, a skin weapon, or decoration?
How does a Huggable Splicer kill or knockback look in BBH, and is there any hit status effect? What do the Splicer and the turret sound like?
Does the Splicer fire whole Huggables or only 'bits'? One 2026 hero-screen tile shows a whole pink Huggable flying from the muzzle; gameplay tiles show only magenta puffs.
